title: Locally finitely presented morphisms with unique infinitesimal lifts are etale
statement: Let $c:W\to Z$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Suppose that for every first order thickening $j:T_0\hookrightarrow T$ of affine schemes [def-sbc-first-order-thickening], every pair of scheme morphisms $a_0:T_0\to W$ and $b:T\to Z$ with $c a_0=bj$ admits exactly one morphism $a:T\to W$ satisfying $aj=a_0$ and $ca=b$. Then $c$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism].

source.place: Tag 02HM, lemma-etale-formally-etale, implication (2) to (1), with Tag 02HG, definition-formally-etale, the unique-lifting formulation for affine first order thickenings.

proof.text: For arbitrary affine opens U in Z and V in W with c(V) contained in U, use LocallyOfFinitePresentation.finitePresentation_appLE to give the section algebra Gamma(W,V) finite presentation over Gamma(Z,U). Prove its etaleness; these are precisely the section maps required by Etale.etale_appLE.

source.place: Tag 02HM, converse affine reduction; morphisms.tex Tag 02GI.

proof.text: Let D be any algebra over Gamma(Z,U), I a square-zero ideal, and v:Gamma(W,V)->D/I an algebra map. The quotient map q gives a closed immersion Spec(D/I)->Spec D. Compute its kernel ideal sheaf on the affine target from the kernel of q, transported through GammaSpecIso; Ideal.le_comap_pow and I^2=0 prove that its square is zero. Thus it is a first-order thickening. The algebra compatibility equation translates by functoriality of Spec and SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec to a square into W and Z; apply the hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 02HL, affine ring translation, and Tag 02HM converse.

proof.text: A square-zero closed immersion j is surjective on points: support(j.ker)=support(j.ker^2)=support(0) is the whole target, while support(j.ker) is the closed image of j. Consequently a(Spec D) lies in V, since its composite with j factors through Spec Gamma(W,V). IsOpenImmersion.lift factors a through the chart inclusion. The two triangles cancel through the open chart inclusions. Full faithfulness of Spec identifies this factorization with a ring map r; the base triangle makes r an algebra map, and the thickening triangle says q composed with r equals v. Conversely any algebra lift gives a scheme lift, so uniqueness in the hypothesis and cancellation of the chart inclusion imply uniqueness of the algebra lift.

source.place: Tags 02HK and 02HL, restriction to opens and affine ring translation.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_comp_bijective to the bijectivity just proved. Its reverse implication applies FormallyUnramified.iff_comp_injective_of_small to uniqueness, giving vanishing Kahler differentials, and FormallySmooth.of_comp_surjective to existence, giving vanishing H1Cotangent. Thus these are the two stated ring lifting criteria, combined without a new intermediate declaration.

source.place: Tag 00UR, formally etale and etale, using Tags 00TN and 00UO.

proof.text: Combine Algebra.FormallyEtale with the finite-presentation instance using Algebra.Etale.mk. RingHom.Etale is defined by this algebra condition. This is the ring etaleness in the affine comparison criterion, and each arbitrary affine section map now satisfies it. Supply these section maps directly to Etale.mk to conclude Etale c, including the empty source case.

proof_origin.place: Tags 02HK, 02HL, and 02HM converse, formalized by W2 using Mathlib Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_comp_bijective and Algebra.Etale.mk (2026-10-26).
